fields_added.location: null when unavailable, otherwise start/end {line,column}, one-based Unicode scalars

positions.human: workspace-relative path:line:column; tabs one scalar, CRLF one break
positions.lsp: zero-based UTF-16; no split surrogate pairs; EOF valid

compatibility: v1 bytes and legacy help retained; v2 uses current compiler-owned help; no source snippets or arbitrary token spellings
streams: existing authoring failure stream and exit code retained
